appearance: Mid-50s, compact, precise. Jaw scar he doesn't discuss.
and_yet: Former caravan guard — too rough for the job he does now.
wants: Resolution before Rakhmoth arrives, without martyrs.
does_not_want: Acting without evidence — expulsion makes martyrs.
oddly_also: Keeps a private list of everyone who has traveled to the Mountain of Fire.
family: Estranged wife in Orziben; three grown children he rarely sees.
self_image: The man holding things together until someone wiser decides.
recreation: Sharpens his knife at the end of every day whether it needs it or not.
dreams: Dravesa quiet enough that nobody needs a warden.
anecdotes: Talked a Bronze Host raiding party into leaving a steading unmolested with no weapons drawn.
tragedies: The wife left when he took this posting. He thought she'd come around.
pc_leverage: Solid evidence on Savar → coin and a letter of passage for Orziben.
